rootCauses: direct callers bypassed BG166-origin refresh coalescing
projection rebuild and cache writes occurred per BG167 invocation even without effective state change
BG168 materiality gating happened after dispatch cost was already incurred
no global single-flight and credit circuit breaker across control-plane callers
overlapping refresh ownership was not globally enforced
configuration drift can exist when throttling logic is duplicated across code and mapper
Make inactive state does not act as a circuit breaker for an on-demand subscenario that is still invoked by another scenario; deactivation alone is therefore insufficient containment

runtimeFixes.purpose: direct read/rebuild callers terminate before Notion read and cache writes

recovery.reactivation: one component at a time after bounded concurrent regression evidence is green
recovery.rollback: return component to safe mode immediately if credit slope or 429 rate regresses
